Prior Day High / Low (PDH / PDL)

Previous trading day high and low. The playbook treats these as important intraday liquidity references and frequent objectives.

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Use the correct product trading-day definition.
  2. Mark previous completed session high and low.
  3. Check alignment with Daily draw on liquidity.
Map intraday objectives and possible sweep locations.

Common mistakes and limitations

Do not mix exchange session dates, chart timezone and calendar dates.
